newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin sets 4-wk T-bill auction for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin sets 4-wk T-bill auction for Thursday.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry will auction a 3.5 billion crown tranche of four-week treasury bills on Thursday with a limit price on bids equal to a maximum yield of 12.40 percent, the central bank said on Wednesday.

Bids in the American-style auction are due by 1100 local time (0900 GMT) on Thursday. The nearest relevant maturity on the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR), one-month money, stood at 12.65 percent on Wednesday up one basis basis point from Tuesday.
